headline: Party rentals delivered across Riverdale, the Bronx & Lower Westchester
subheadline: Tents, tables, chairs, inflatables, lighting, dance floors, and event essentials — delivered with professional setup for backyards, schools, weddings, and celebrations.

minimumOrder.display: Downstate complete-event deliveries generally start around $1,500 before tax. The exact minimum depends on service zone, event date, equipment, access, and setup requirements.

areas.name: Riverdale
areas.summary: Backyard celebrations, school events, weddings, family parties, and premium residential setups.
areas.details: Riverdale is the center of our Downstate service area. We focus on backyard parties, milestone celebrations, school events, ceremonies, and receptions where a full rental order can be delivered and professionally set up.

areas.name: Fieldston
areas.summary: Residential events with room for tents, seating, lighting, and upscale backyard layouts.
areas.details: Fieldston events often benefit from a site review before a tent is selected. Driveways, lawns, gates, slopes, overhead clearance, and the planned guest layout can change the best tent and anchoring method.

areas.name: Kingsbridge
areas.summary: Neighborhood parties, schools, community events, tables, chairs, tents, and inflatables.
areas.details: Kingsbridge orders are quoted around access and setup conditions first. Compact yards, paved areas, schools, churches, and community spaces can each require a different equipment plan.

areas.name: Yonkers
areas.summary: Backyard parties, graduations, weddings, school events, inflatables, and full event setups.
areas.details: Yonkers gives us a strong mix of residential, school, venue, and community-event opportunities. We quote the complete setup around the address, surface, access, event hours, and pickup requirements.

areas.name: Mount Vernon
areas.summary: Tent packages, backyard parties, family events, tables, chairs, and entertainment rentals.
areas.details: Mount Vernon orders are built around complete event setups rather than small one-item deliveries. Combining tents, seating, tables, lighting, and entertainment helps keep the Downstate route efficient.

areas.name: New Rochelle
areas.summary: Weddings, backyard events, graduations, tent rentals, seating, lighting, and event packages.
areas.details: New Rochelle events can range from backyard celebrations to more formal receptions. We confirm property access, setup surface, tent clearances, delivery timing, and venue requirements before finalizing the quote.

areas.name: The Bronx
areas.summary: Selected Bronx locations with site-appropriate tenting, inflatables, tables, chairs, and event rentals.
areas.details: We serve selected Bronx locations where the order, access, surface, and setup plan fit our equipment and route. For tents and inflatables, a site review may be required before the booking is confirmed.
idealFor: Frame-style setups on suitable paved sites

areas.name: Lower Westchester
areas.summary: A connected service area for premium suburban events with more room for tents and inflatables.
areas.details: Lower Westchester is a priority growth corridor for Friendly Party Rental because complete backyard and event setups can combine the inventory we already specialize in: tents, seating, inflatables, lighting, dance floors, and event extras.

services.name: Tent Rentals
services.blurb: Pole tents for suitable grass sites plus frame-style options for paved or space-sensitive setups.
services.details: Choose the tent around the property first: grass, pavement, access, guest count, tables, walkways, food service, and any dance floor all affect the right setup.
highlights: Pole tents for suitable grass sites

services.name: Tables & Chairs
services.blurb: Folding chairs, resin chairs, Chiavari seating, banquet tables, round tables, and cocktail tables.
services.details: Build seating around the number of guests who need seats at the same time, then add serving, gift, cocktail, buffet, and registration tables separately.
highlights: Gold, white and mahogany Chiavari options

services.name: Bounce Houses & Water Slides
services.blurb: Family-focused inflatables for suitable private properties, schools, and approved event sites.
services.details: Inflatables work best on sites with adequate flat space, a clear access path, proper anchoring, and suitable power. Water units also require a workable water source.

services.name: Weddings & Receptions
services.blurb: Tents, seating, linens, lighting, cocktail tables, dance floors, and coordinated setup.
services.details: Wedding orders can combine tenting, ceremony seating, reception tables, linens, lighting, cocktail tables, dance floor, photo booth options, and coordinated setup.

services.name: Event Extras
services.blurb: Bistro lighting, fans, dance floors, concessions, games, photo booth options, coolers, and more.
services.details: Finish the event with practical and entertainment add-ons sized around your tent, guest count, power plan, and venue rules.
